delivery_method.justification: Revised reference; five documented delivery methods, no values seeded.

payment_method.justification: Revised reference; manual payment-method selection/instructions, not a gateway.

unit_of_measure.justification: Revised reference; quantities and costing material measurement units.

filter_type.justification: Revised reference; sixteen filter types/six template groups, no fictional values.

production_stage.justification: Revised reference and ten-stage requirement; labels/order values remain unpopulated.

user_account.justification: Revised common account identity; client_user is a shared-PK subtype, not another credential store.

client_user.justification: Revised portal membership. Common login attributes reside once in user_account; approved one-company-login uniqueness retained.

document.justification: Revised document entity with private object identity/lifecycle required by security and auditability; no second files subsystem.

inquiry_item.justification: Revised requested-item specifications directly on the item; JSON accommodates the documented six template groups, not a copied specification master.

cost_estimate.justification: Revised per-quotation-item estimate; nonunique item FK preserves estimate history without deciding one-current-estimate policy.

raw_material.justification: Revised raw material plus explicitly approved unknown/sample/verified provenance and reference-versus-approved price safeguards; no import lineage clone.

cost_estimate_material.justification: Revised material-cost snapshot; category/UOM describe estimate-time measurement, not a second current stock balance.

purchase_order.justification: Accepted quotation is the only commercial owner link; inquiry/client and downpayment facts derive through quotation, not duplicate FK/boolean state.

attributeResolution.downpayment_confirmed: derived confirmed invoice payment facts; no duplicate mutable flag
attributeResolution.downpayment_confirmed_date: derived confirmed invoice payment review history; no fabricated allocation/date

job_order.justification: Revised single PO header; no copied inquiry/client/accepted quote owner IDs and no product-level legacy JO.

attributeResolution.issue_sales_invoice: omitted: invoice precedes JO in documented workflow

job_order_item.justification: Revised item-level immutable manufacturing specifications, including structured six-template snapshot; no mutable product master reference.

finished_good.justification: Revised client-specific repeat-product inventory; quantities and thresholds are unknown until observed. Forecast attributes are not populated.

stock_movement.justification: Revised single typed movement ledger; provenance, required actor/reason, unit evidence and replay identity support genuine first observations without fictitious zero.

stock_request.justification: Stock-request entity shown in supplied cardinality diagram and newer handoff Warehouse/Sales backlog, absent from revised text attribute sections.

stock_request_item.justification: Diagram request item plus Q02-approved provenance distinction; it is an immutable request-time snapshot, not a second live inventory balance.

sales_invoice.justification: Invoice follows PO acceptance before payment/JO in documented use cases; JO/client derive through PO, avoiding a circular mandatory JO FK.

attributeResolution.jo_id: derived job_order.po_id; no mandatory pre-JO cycle

client_receipt.justification: Revised proof submission, not a payment; document_id expands to client_receipt_file for explicitly documented multi-photo submissions.

payment_transaction.justification: Confirmed-only money, one row per partial/full payment; optional nonunique receipt FK does not impose allocation cardinality or copy attachment amounts.

delivery.justification: Revised delivery aggregate, many deliveries per JO. PO/invoice/client derive through JO; document numbers and signed files live in required document entities.

client_receipt_file.justification: Final.pdf scope p12 explicitly requires multi-photo receipt uploads; one submission amount is independent from the number of documents.

waybill.justification: Documented Warehouse generation/printing and Logistics QR verification; waybill is not a shipment or second delivery aggregate.

delivery_receipt.justification: Final.pdf pp47-49: Accounting generates a DR after dispatch; unlike waybill, it is a different document and responsible role.

signed_delivery_receipt.justification: Final.pdf pp50-51: signed DR upload/retention by Client or Logistics after delivery. Multiple retained uploads do not overwrite one file on delivery.

production_stage_event.justification: Backlog requires timestamped staff attribution and required reversion reason; this append-only event trail is not a second stage-state tracker.

audit_event.justification: Explicit inventory audit/reason and cross-role historical traceability requirements; polymorphic historical subject IDs intentionally survive lifecycle changes.

triggers.name: client_user_role_bi
triggers.body: IF (SELECT r.role_name FROM user_account u JOIN role r ON r.role_id=u.role_id WHERE u.user_id=NEW.client_user_id)<>'Client' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Portal profile requires Client role'; END IF;

triggers.name: inquiry_client_id_history
triggers.body: IF NOT(NEW.client_id<=>OLD.client_id) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quotation WHERE inquiry_id=OLD.inquiry_id)) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Cannot reassign historical ownership'; END IF;

triggers.name: quotation_inquiry_id_history
triggers.body: IF NOT(NEW.inquiry_id<=>OLD.inquiry_id) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quotation_item WHERE quotation_id=OLD.quotation_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM purchase_order WHERE quotation_id=OLD.quotation_id)) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Cannot reassign historical ownership'; END IF;

triggers.name: job_order_po_id_history
triggers.body: IF NOT(NEW.po_id<=>OLD.po_id) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_order_item WHERE jo_id=OLD.jo_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM delivery WHERE jo_id=OLD.jo_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM production_plan WHERE jo_id=OLD.jo_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_movement WHERE jo_id=OLD.jo_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_order_stage WHERE jo_id=OLD.jo_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_shortage_report WHERE jo_id=OLD.jo_id)) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Cannot reassign historical ownership'; END IF;
